title: Proposed Library
coverAlt: Exterior view of the proposed Library in Hubli
storyTitle: Three wings around a shared centre
description: This fifth-semester proposal for KLE C.I.M Polytechnic organizes the library as three angled wings around a central shared space.

The ground floor gathers public reading, the children’s section, canteen and administration around the entrance. The upper floor contains the digital library, study halls and auditorium. This concept text is a draft for student review.
